positioning.en: Android systems depth, full-stack delivery, and software agents with proof.

summary.en: State, tools, retries, human approval, limits, and failure recovery.
summary.zh-Hant: 狀態、工具、重試、人工確認、限制與失敗恢復。

summary.en: Reusable SKILL.md packages with code execution and assertions.
summary.zh-Hant: 可重用的 SKILL.md 套件，包含程式執行與斷言檢查。

summary.en: Tests, schemas, evidence records, and fail-closed delivery gates.
summary.zh-Hant: 測試、Schema、證據紀錄與失敗即停止的交付檢查。

summary.en: Checks whether a SKILL.md package can run, validate, and report results across agent tools.
summary.zh-Hant: 檢查 SKILL.md 套件能否在不同 Agent 工具中執行、驗證並回報結果。

summary.en: Tests whether generated project documents stay tied to source code and traceable evidence.

summary.en: Builds repeatable experiments for systems that can only be observed from the outside.
summary.zh-Hant: 為只能從外部觀察的系統建立可重複實驗。

summary.en: Defines practical limits for tools, prompts, permissions, and agent actions.
summary.zh-Hant: 為工具、提示詞、權限與 Agent 行為定義實際限制。

summary.en: Reference pipeline for admitting, tracing, reviewing, and rolling back post-training data.
summary.zh-Hant: 後訓練資料的准入、追蹤、審查與回滾參考流程。

summary.en: Routes model work by task needs, cost, and quality limits.
